before.note_en: The investor announcement confirms Fadron as an investment but does not disclose the amount, stake, instrument details or exact closing date; the announcement date is used.

after.note_en: Neo Autonomy's launch release names Fadron among its initial investments by 17 February 2026. The financing instrument, amount, stake and closing date are undisclosed.

before.note_en: The group history confirms continuity from Empresa Nacional Santa Bárbara to Santa Bárbara Sistemas within General Dynamics. Consideration and exact completion date are not disclosed on the checked source.

after.note_en: General Dynamics reported that it acquired Empresa Nacional Santa Bárbara de Industrias Militares and Santa Bárbara Blindados on 25 July 2001. The acquired companies were combined as Santa Bárbara Sistemas. The date is completion. Individual transaction consideration and primary proceeds are undisclosed.

added_source.title: General Dynamics 2001 annual report, business combinations note
